target: Component interaction reliability, reusable examples and local development

checks: select links its named listbox and skips disabled or hidden options
select typeahead moves focus without committing until Enter
Space opens a select with non-button options without immediately choosing one
select cannot commit an aria-disabled option
select Tab and Shift+Tab continue from the trigger
popups close when focus leaves and opening another popup closes the first
menu keyboard skips disabled actions and dispatches checkbox selections
tabs never select disabled tabs and ignore hidden tabs
context menu works with Shift+F10, arrow keys and Escape
tooltip adds and removes its description without losing existing hints
tooltip is reachable inside a native modal and Escape dismisses it first
dragging from a dialog panel onto the backdrop does not close it
a select near the bottom of a mobile viewport stays within the viewport
command palette does not execute while confirming an IME composition
command search normalizes full-width input and matches multiple words
chart treats dynamic labels and values as text
unknown theme names fall back to light instead of inherited object keys
token refresh leaves unchanged content alone and rapid changes show the final theme
a native modal blocks background scrolling until closed
showcase and starter fit 320px in light
showcase and starter fit 390px in light
showcase and starter fit 768px in light
showcase and starter fit 1024px in light
showcase and starter fit 1440px in light
showcase and starter fit 320px in forest-dark
showcase and starter fit 390px in forest-dark
showcase and starter fit 768px in forest-dark
showcase and starter fit 1024px in forest-dark
showcase and starter fit 1440px in forest-dark
all nine theme cards and the header selector stay synchronized
mobile navigation hands focus to search and closes with Escape
component and icon filters survive reload and recover from empty results
all 22 exported component pages load their references and stay interactive
starter preferences still persist with native form controls
open select and command palette have no structural accessibility violations
direct file preview keeps local assets and interactions working

accessibility.scope: Whole showcase, initial light theme, 1440px desktop; axe-core WCAG 2 A/AA and 2.1 AA tags
accessibility.structuralChecks: Open select and command palette pass automated structural checks; keyboard and focus behavior are exercised separately.
accessibility.limitation: The source palette is preserved. Its 75 color-contrast node findings remain; this is not a site-wide WCAG conformance claim.
